title: Entry rules for a US passport holder
intro: Rules below are taken from the National Immigration Administration (NIA) policy pages. Items marked unverified were not confirmed on an official page.

rows.us_status: Yes — 'United States' is on the list of 57 countries
rows.details: Ordinary passport; enter and leave through one of 65 designated ports in 24 provincial-level regions; stay up to 10 days (240 hours), counted from 00:00 the day after arrival; must hold onward tickets with confirmed seats to a third country or region. Activities allowed include travel, business, visits and family reunions. Work, study and news reporting need prior approval.
rows.trip_fit: Works only if the trip is a transit: arrive from one place, leave for a third place. A 10-day stay is the maximum, so 7 nights fits and 14 nights does not.

rows.us_status: Yes — 'the United States' is on the list of 61 countries
rows.details: Ordinary passport; stay up to 30 days in Hainan Province for tourism, business, visits, family visits, medical treatment, conferences, sports events. Work and study excluded. All open ports in Hainan are eligible.
rows.trip_fit: A possible alternative: a Hainan-only trip (for example Sanya or Haikou) needs no visa under this policy. It does not cover Shanghai or any other mainland city.

source.label: NIA — Regional Visa-Free Entry Policies (20 Aug 2026)

rows.us_status: UNVERIFIED — secondary sources say the US is NOT on this list
rows.details: Not checked on an official NIA page in this session. Must be confirmed before relying on it.
rows.trip_fit: If the US is not on this list, a normal Shanghai tourist trip needs a Chinese tourist (L) visa.
